text:
Priya (Finance Ops): Heads up — customer 'BrightLayer' downgraded their AWS listing mid-cycle. Marketplace billing shows both PRO and STANDARD SKUs for the same subscription. They've requested a rebill + prorated refund. Attaching invoice + usage export, need guidance on manual rebill flow and signoff. https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood/invoices/1764123456-brightlayer-original.pdf

Alex (Partner Ops): Which SKUs are showing? can you paste the usage rows or CSV? Also, any marketplace settlement notes we should be aware of?

Priya (Finance Ops): Here's the CSV extract we pulled from the marketplace export:

```
sku,usage_quantity,unit_price
aws-bright-pro,1200,0.10
aws-bright-standard,300,0.05
```

Subscription id: sub_0a9c8f, downgrade effective 2024-11-12 08:00 UTC. Invoice link: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood/invoices/1764123456-brightlayer-original.pdf

Trevor (Revenue Ops): Got it. Two quick Qs: (1) Do we treat this as a standard prorate (days-based) or a marketplace-specific rule? (2) estimated $$ impact on ARR / one-time refund?

Priya (Finance Ops): We'll do daily proration per AWS Marketplace guidance for listing downgrades. Estimated refund ~ $420 before fees. See export for tokenized usage.

Maria (Finance Manager): For manual rebills > $5k we need Director signoff and GL impact doc. This seems < $5k but confirm gross invoice amounts. Also need the journal entry lines for reversal + credit memo.

Jordan (Revenue Director): Approve the rebill approach. Please cc accounting@redwood.com on the credit memo and include PO/reference from the seller.

Alex (Partner Ops): I'll draft the credit memo + replacement invoice. Plan: create credit equal to the prorated portion of PRO sku, then reissue invoiced usage on STANDARD sku for remaining days. Routing note: this must go through AWS Partner Billing with settlement hold for marketplace fee.

Priya (Finance Ops): Confirmed daily proration. Downgrade date used as effective start for new SKU. Also flag: partner fee withholding applies (12.5% per contract). We'll capture withholding when posting.

Accounting Bot: Created accounting ticket FIN-4827 for manual credit + rebill. Assigned to @trevor and @alex.

Trevor (Revenue Ops): I'll create the Netsuite credit memo after Alex uploads the final draft invoice. Need the marketplace fee withheld amount to book the net refund. Alex, can you confirm final fee line?

Alex (Partner Ops): Draft uploaded: https://redwood.docs/invoices/1764123456-brightlayer-rebill-draft.pdf. Included a 12.5% marketplace fee line and the prorated credit. @Priya please confirm and I'll submit to accounting. :thumbsup:

Priya (Finance Ops): Looks good to me — confirm to proceed. Once accounting posts we'll notify BrightLayer and attach the settlement reference.

Alex (Partner Ops): Submitting to accounting now. Will update FIN-4827 with NS doc links. :white_check_mark:
